name: ft-location-policy-blocked
description: R210 P2 (security plan section 3): the Permissions-Policy-blocked context, verified after the R208 fix to geolocation=(self). The top-level same-origin document must be ALLOWED to ask (permission state 'prompt' - the fix's whole purpose); an EMBEDDED context (a transient sandboxed srcdoc iframe carrying an opaque origin - the class an embedder without allow=geolocation creates) must be DENIED by the policy. The probe iframe posts its result to the page and is removed after the read (a measurement instrument on evalExpect's read-only escape hatch - never touches app state; disclosed in the R210 plan).

steps.name: serving-header-geolocation-self
steps.expr: (() => { const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('GET', '/', false); x.send(); const h = x.getAllResponseHeaders(); const line = h.split('\r\n').find((l) => l.toLowerCase().startsWith('permissions-policy')) || 'none'; return 'policy=' + line })()

steps.name: embedded-context-denied-by-policy
steps.expr: (() => new Promise((resolve) => { const f = document.createElement('iframe'); f.setAttribute('sandbox', 'allow-scripts'); f.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); f.setAttribute('style', 'display:none'); f.srcdoc = '<scr' + 'ipt>navigator.permissions.query({ name: "geolocation" }).then(function (s) { parent.postMessage({ r210embeddedGeo: s.state }, "*"); }).catch(function (e) { parent.postMessage({ r210embeddedGeo: "err:" + e.name }, "*"); })</scr' + 'ipt>'; let done = false; const finish = (v) => { if (done) return; done = true; window.removeEventListener('message', onMsg); clearTimeout(t); f.remove(); resolve('embedded=' + v); }; const onMsg = (ev) => { if (ev.data && typeof ev.data.r210embeddedGeo === 'string') finish(ev.data.r210embeddedGeo); }; window.addEventListener('message', onMsg); const t = setTimeout(() => finish('timeout'), 5000); document.body.appendChild(f); }))()
